conbody.p: Warning message: Use switch or pedal to accelerate
In traffic, your vehicle will stop if the vehicle ahead of you stops. Also, if the vehicle ahead of you starts moving, your vehicle will start as well.

In addition, after the vehicle has stopped and a certain time has passed, the warning message will appear on the cluster. Depress the accelerator pedal or operate the () switch, () switch or () switch to start driving.

note.p: If Forward Attention Warning (in-cabin camera) is equipped, the allowable stop time for automatic departure may be extended depending on the driver’s forward attention.
